method: Each creature event named in a monster file was classified by a model-assisted read of its registering script and same-file helpers; evidence_lines point at the decisive lines. Five omission-eligible classifications (BlackKnightDeath, SparkDeath, UglyMonsterDeath, RenegadeOrcDeath, InquisitionBossDeath) were re-read by hand and confirmed. Only high-confidence quest, encounter_bookkeeping and no_effect events are omitted by canary_batch.py; every other event stays unresolved.

kinds.encounter_bookkeeping: boss or encounter state for players or globals only (D9)
kinds.encounter_mechanic: changes the fight or world (D9: Encounter)
kinds.no_effect: not registered, or no observable effect
